hook: Your road here ends with sea on both sides.
title: Your Road Ends at India's Ghost Town
description:
Dhanushkodi in Tamil Nadu sits at the tip of Rameswaram island, with the Bay of Bengal on one side and the Indian Ocean on the other. A cyclone in 1964 wrecked the town. Ruins still stand there today.

#Shorts #Dhanushkodi #Geography
